content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for OERC Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: www.orierc.org. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 28-08-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the OERC Consultant recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for the OERC Consultant (Research Associate) posts is 28 August 2026. Candidates are advised to ensure their applications reach the commission before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Consultant post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 6 vacancies for the Consultant (Research Associate) posts in the Odisha Electricity Regulatory Commission (OERC).

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Consultant (Research Associate) posts?
faq.answer: The educational qualifications vary by specialization: Graduation in Electrical Engineering (65% marks), Degree in Law (55% marks), or B. Com (60% marks).

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applying to these posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all Consultant (Research Associate) posts is 35 years. Age relaxation will be applicable as per government norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Consultant positions?
faq.answer: The salary for the Consultant positions ranges from Rs. 30,000 to Rs. 40,000 per month, depending on the specific role.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for OERC recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the OERC Consultant recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve shortlisting of applications followed by an interview of the shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply for the OERC Consultant (Research Associate) posts?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted offline. Candidates need to download the application form from the official website, fill it out, and send it via Speed Post or Registered Post to the address specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q9. What is the official website of the Odisha Electricity Regulatory Commission?
faq.answer: The official website of the Odisha Electricity Regulatory Commission is www.orierc.org.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: The recruitment for the Consultant (Research Associate) posts is on a contractual basis.
